## What changed, by surface

CARD CHROME (CSS plumbing, not artwork)
- `.dh-state` badge: position:absolute -> static in the flex head.
  Measured overlap with the controls strip 171x13px -> 0.
- `.dh-saved` toast: moved top-right -> bottom-right.
- `--dh-shot-w` fallback: 96px -> clamp(96px,18vw,240px).
  Thumbnail box 96x124 -> 230x298. Inner comp scale 0.1106 -> 0.2682.

HARNESS PLUMBING (not visible in the round)
- deliver.py: URL now read from `open` instead of scraped from `publish`
  stdout. Before this the script aborted after step 2 of 4 on every run.
- deliver.py: assessments precondition hoisted above all subprocess steps.
- review_delivery.py: review image render width 510 -> 1280 (REVIEW_WIDTH).
- test_deliver.py: rewritten, 3 tests -> 4; fixture corrected to return
  publish's real "Serving ..." line instead of a URL it never returns.
- bootstrap_harness.py: CONTROLS_VERSION 37 -> 38; shot-width fallbacks.

DOCUMENTATION
- BUGS.md: B-025 (all @container rules dead), B-026 (audit-svg red, inline
  SVG, sprite-sheet extraction deferred), B-027 (installed skill is a copy
  outside the repo).

THE GRAPHIC ITSELF
- design/landing-flow-hero.html: one line of change, the stacked-layout
  breakpoint 900px -> 780px (carried over from the previous shot).
- No change to the isometric rail, the four rooms, the room bosses, the
  signature items, the palette, the type, or the composition.
- No new proposal, no new cohort element, no superseded element.
- Element `landing.hero.flow.foundation` remains `proposed`, 0 stars in the
  ledger, sentiment `like`.

22/23 pass. `contracts-budget` red (pre-existing R-15, four files over the
30000-byte budget; the one file touched was already 215204 bytes).
